_readme: H1236: per-family engine recordings. To activate: rename this file
to manifest.json, drop seamless loop WAVs in this folder, and list
them below. Each family needs TWO loops: idle + rev (the rev loop
is pitch-shifted across the whole RPM range automatically).
Families: i4 i6 v6 v8 v10 v12 f4(boxer) rot(rotary) b2 b4 hd(harley).
Any family NOT listed keeps the procedural synth voice. Turbo/
supercharger whine, blow-off, shift pops and clutch-cut layer on
